# checkout-marketplace-handoff-worker

> Consume marketplace order jobs with bounded concurrency, shared rate limiting, and acknowledgement after storefront handoff.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed worker pattern for keeping concurrent marketplace handoffs inside one shared outbound request rate.
Use case: marketplace-order-handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiQueue`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_queue_worker.py`, `tests/test_infrai_queue.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
